title: Fuse to Recognize the Unseen: Class-Relative Infrared-Visible Fusion for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2611.24316v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Visible-infrared image fusion leverages complementary thermal cues to enhance visual perception, particularly under challenging illumination. However, such perceptual complementarity does not readily translate into semantic gains in open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS), where CLIP-based models are predominantly pretrained on RGB imagery. Directly introducing IR information may instead disrupt RGB-language alignment, turning promising thermal cues into semantic interference that undermines unseen-class recognition. Our pixel-level RGB-IR semantic analysis reveals that class-relevant thermal cues can correct certain RGB misclassifications while preserving reliable RGB predictions, motivating RGB-anchored, class-relative thermal cue selection. Based on this insight, we propose EmergeFuse, an infrared-visible fusion framework for OVSS that selectively converts complementary thermal evidence into unseen-class semantic corrections. S

translated_title: 融合以识别未见类别：面向开放词汇语义分割的类别相对红外-可见光融合
translated_abstract: 可见光-红外图像融合利用互补的热信息来增强视觉感知，尤其在具有挑战性的光照条件下效果显著。然而，这种感知上的互补性并不能直接转化为开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）中的语义增益，因为基于CLIP的模型主要是在RGB图像上进行预训练的。直接引入红外信息反而可能破坏RGB与语言模态之间的对齐，使原本有价值的热线索变成语义干扰，从而损害对未见类别的识别能力。我们的像素级RGB-IR语义分析表明，与类别相关的热线索能够纠正某些RGB误分类，同时保留可靠的RGB预测结果，这启发我们提出以RGB为锚点、类别相对的热线索选择机制。基于这一洞察，我们提出了EmergeFuse——一个面向开放词汇语义分割的红外-可见光融合框架，它能够选择性地将互补的热证据转化为对未见类别的语义修正。
tldr: 提出EmergeFuse框架，通过以RGB为锚点的类别相对热线索选择机制，将红外热信息选择性地转化为开放词汇语义分割中未见类别的语义修正，同时避免破坏CLIP的RGB-语言对齐。
en_tdlr: We propose EmergeFuse, an infrared-visible fusion framework for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation that selectively converts complementary thermal cues into unseen-class semantic corrections through RGB-anchored, class-relative cue selection, while avoiding disruption of CLIP's RGB-language alignment.
